resources.name: AMBER force field parameters for s-PS, benzene, and chloroform

access.notes: Parameters from published literature: non-bonded parameters for s-PS from Tamai & Fukuda (Polymer 2003); benzene parameters from Cornell et al. (JACS 1995) and Howard et al. (Chem. Phys. Lett. 1995); chloroform parameters from Fox & Kollman (JPCB 1998). The agent must assemble these from the public references.

resources.name: Experimental crystal structure of δe s-PS

access.notes: Fractional coordinates from de Rosa et al., Macromolecules 30, 4147 (1997). Space group P2₁/a, cell parameters a≈17.4 Å, b≈11.85 Å, c≈7.70 Å, γ≈117°.
